title: Mtek test report
description: The single JSON document that `mtek test --format json` prints on stdout (spec/tooling.md section 6, decision 0074). Schema version 1: keys are only ever added within a version. A report is a result, never a pass by default: `status` is `pass` only when at least one fixture ran and every fixture passed.

project.description: `project.name` of mtek.toml; null when the project could not be loaded.

status.description: `fail` if any fixture failed, the project does not build, a fixture file is invalid, there is no fixture or the tool itself failed; else `not-run` if any fixture could not run; else `pass`.

exitCode.description: The exit code of the process: 0 for `pass`, and for `not-run` with allowNotRun; 1 for `fail`, and for `not-run` without allowNotRun; 3 when the tool itself failed (a crashed runner, a scratch directory that cannot be created, a build that could not be written; the document is still printed when it can be). 2 (usage error) prints no report.

error.description: A problem that belongs to no fixture: no fixtures found, a fixture directory that cannot be listed, no project found, the tool's own failure. Null otherwise.

build.description: The build of the project in test mode; null when the run ended before the build (no fixtures, a directory that cannot be listed).

diagnostics.description: The `diagnostics` array of the report of spec/diagnostics.md section 2.2 (each item validates against spec/diagnostic.schema.json).

environment.description: The browser and the WebGPU adapter the fixtures ran on; null when the browser did not start or no fixture was sent to it.

reason.description: Why there is no adapter; null when there is one.

isFallbackAdapter.description: True for a software adapter: correctness evidence only, never hardware evidence.

fixtures.description: One entry per fixture file, in file name order.

file.description: The path relative to the project, `/` as the separator.

name.description: `name` of the fixture; the file path when the file could not be read that far.

reason.description: Why the fixture is NOT-RUN; null otherwise.

failure.description: What failed; null unless the status is `fail`.

kind.description: `invalid-fixture` (the file has problems, see details), `build` (the project does not build), `mount` (the program did not mount), `step` (a step threw), `set_input` (the input was rejected), `runtime-error` (the program reported an error diagnostic, see details), `timeout`, or the kind of the expectation that did not hold: `expect_state`, `expect_pixel`, `expect_counter`.

step.description: The 1-based index of the step that failed.

line.description: The 1-based line of that step in the fixture file.
